scripts.deploy: H=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && D=$(mktemp -d) && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D" && mkdir -p "$D/public" && find "$D" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name 'public' ! -name 'functions' ! -name 'wrangler.toml' -exec mv -t "$D/public" {} + && rm -rf "$D/public/test" "$D/public/server.mjs" "$D/public/schema.sql" && (cd "$D" && npx --yes wrangler@4.86.0 pages deploy public --project-name dramapuchi --branch main --commit-hash "$H" && npx --yes wrangler@4.86.0 pages deploy public --project-name tama-pwa --branch main --commit-hash "$H"); s=$?; rm -rf "$D"; exit $s
